result.brief: ForeAct3D 在 VLA 策略内做动作条件化的未来语义 3D 世界建模，通过物理一致性约束塑造共享表征，提升机器人操作成功率。
result.reason: Policy-grounded future world modeling with semantic 3D scene states and action-conditioned future prediction shapes shared VLA representation; main contribution is robot policy/world modeling application.
